sections.content:
Population change in Forest Heath

The population in Forest Heath is projected to increase from 65,399 in 2018 to 70,381 people in 2028.

The biggest factor in population change is births and deaths, which will increase the population by 3,462.

This is different to the majority of areas in England, where net internal migration is projected to be the biggest factor in population change.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Forest Heath
sections.subtitle: How the population is projected to change, by cause
sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Subnational population projections for England.

sections.content:
In Forest Heath, this is how all the different factors are projected to contribute to population change between 2018 and 2028:

  • More births than deaths mean that the population is projected to increase by 5.3% (3,462), compared with an increase of 1.6% in England, with 9,383 births and 5,921 deaths in Forest Heath between 2018 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) is projected to increase the population by 5.0% (3,270), with 38,681 people entering the area and 35,411 people leaving the area between 2018 and 2028.
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) is projected to increase the population by 0.2% (107), with 797 people entering the area and 690 people leaving the area between 2018 and 2028.
  • Net international migration is projected to increase the population by 2.8% (1,856), compared with an increase of 3.5% in England, with 3,582 people entering the area and 5,438 people leaving the area between 2018 and 2028.

sections.content:
Age profile in Forest Heath in 2028

The median age in Forest Heath is projected to remain the same at 35 years between 2018 and 2028.

In England, the median age is projected to be 40 years in 2028.

Between 2018 and 2028, the proportion of people aged 65 years or over in Forest Heath is projected to rise from 18% to 20%.

sections.title: The 10 to 19 age group are set to see the largest increases in Forest Heath over the next 10 years.
sections.subtitle: Proportion of population by 10 year age bands, 2018 and 2028
sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Subnational population projections for England.

sections.content:
Between 2018 and 2028, the working population (people aged 16 years to State Pension age) in Forest Heath is projected to stay the same, at around 56%.

The old age dependency ratio (the number of people of pensionable age for every 1,000 people of working age) is projected to rise from 301 to 353 over the same time period.

This is below average for England in 2028 (319 per 1,000). Nationally, a high old age dependency ratio means more older people are financially reliant on the working population to pay for pensions.

How will the number of young people change in Forest Heath?

Between 2018 and 2028, the number of people aged 18 years and under in Forest Heath is projected to rise from 24% to 26%.

This is slightly above average for England in 2028 (23%).
